text:
sasha (People Ops): Heads-up for the cycle: self-assessments are open now and close Mon Sep 6 23:59 PT. Manager calibration week is Sep 7-11. Full guide + manager upload form: https://redwood.app/docs/perf-cycle-2026. A few operational clarifications below.

dan (Eng Manager): thx Sasha. two quick ones: 1) extension policy? 2) any new required fields on the manager form?

sasha (People Ops): 1) standard extension is up to 3 business days for short absences. for medical or long leaves submit the Exceptions form; pplops aims to respond within 24 business hours on requests flagged as "urgent". 2) new this cycle: we added a "Quality Gate" field on the manager form where one line must link to 1) a metric/dashboard or 2) 1 PR/ship example for the rating to be considered valid. helps with auditors.

li (IC): if someone joined 2 weeks ago do they get a rating? we had confusion last cycle.

sasha (People Ops): policy unchanged: hires <30 days get no formal rating. please add a short "Onboarding & Ramp" note (2 bullets) for hires <90 days so Recruiting + L&D can follow up.

omar (Recruiter): can we make the Onboarding & Ramp field required for <60 day hires? hiring ops needs the visibility.

sasha (People Ops): agreed — set to required for hires <60 days this cycle. keep it 1-3 bullets (focus, checkpoints).

dan (Eng Manager): question on peer feedback: can it be anonymous? last time a few folks were hesitant.

sasha (People Ops): peer feedback remains optional and non-anonymous by default to encourage context. teams may run an anonymized peer survey (separate tool) but anonymized responses cannot be used as the sole evidence for a rating — they should complement manager/metric evidence.

peopleops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Self-assessments deadline in 3 days" will post in #people-ops and department channels.

dan (Eng Manager): for calibration logistics: can we reserve a single 75-min slot for Eng? timezone split hurt us last time.

srini (Director): I can block a 75-min slot Thu Sep 10 08:30-09:45 PT for Eng + Product. If that doesn't work for APAC, post availability to the doodle in the guide and we'll add a second slot.

li (IC): what's the path if a manager wants to change a rating after calibration?

sasha (People Ops): managers can request recalibration within 4 business days of the calibration meeting using the recalibration form. we'll triage; if we escalate we'll ask for the scoring CSV + the Quality Gate evidence (1-2 links). ICs have a separate HR appeals path documented in the policy.

dan (Eng Manager): any naming/format rules for the scoring CSV? last time files were messy.

sasha (People Ops): yep — please use the supplied CSV template and name uploads: teamname_calibration_YYYYMMDD.csv. the submission form will reject non-conforming filenames to avoid processing delays.

omar (Recruiter): one ops ask: can managers add a short "Promotion Signals" bullet? Hiring wants to triage promotable folks quickly.

sasha (People Ops): added an optional Promotion Signals field (1-2 bullets, evidence-based).

peopleops-bot: After manager submit, autogenerated emails (rating + manager comment) will be sent to direct reports within 72 business hours. Managers: review comment text before submit.

dan (Eng Manager): filed an extension for one report out for family emergency. tagging @sasha to confirm.

sasha (People Ops): got the form, Dan  I'll route as urgent and confirm within 24 business hours. please add a brief note in the Context field so the calibrators see it.

srini (Director): quick reminder to calibrators: keep notes factual, link evidence, and add an "audit tag" whenever a rating changes after initial submission. that helps downstream audits.

sasha (People Ops): copy — adding a checklist snippet for invites below (paste into calendar):

```
Subject: Calibration Team {NAME}
Agenda: 1) Context & last cycle notes (5m)
2) Borderline cases + Quality Gate evidence (55m)
3) Finalize ratings, capture Promotion Signals (10m)
Prep: scoring CSV (teamname_calibration_YYYYMMDD.csv), 2 evidence links, list of hires <60d
```

li (IC): thanks, that's super helpful.

sasha (People Ops): any edge-case questions, DM me or ping in thread. we'll keep reminders coming via peopleops-bot. :bell:
